name: The last member of a Dungeon Finder group that falls apart is teleported out of the dungeon
contract: Issue #10561: every member who leaves a Dungeon Finder group inside its dungeon is teleported to their entry
point. When the second to last member leaves, the group disbands and the last member was left inside without a
group, so the finder could no longer teleport them out. They now leave the dungeon like the others.

steps.label: CONTROL: the leaver is teleported out
The last member is teleported out too
